# CWE-89 SQL Injection (test fixture)

Build database queries only with parameterized statements.

- MUST pass every untrusted value as a bound parameter, never by string concatenation.
- MUST NOT build SQL text from request data.

examples.example-python.md:
# Fixture seed example (human-written)
query = "SELECT id FROM users WHERE name = ?"
rows = connection.execute(query, (name,)).fetchall()
